items.title: Cboe Global Markets (CBOE) Stock May Be Fully Priced After KPI Options Launch
items.summary: Cboe Global Markets has logged a powerful run over the past few years, which naturally puts today’s share price under the microscope. With so much of the story tied to earnings, the question now is whether the current valuation still lines up with what the business is actually making. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 189.9%, which raises the issue of how much of that move is grounded in the company’s earnings power versus higher expectations being priced in.
